digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. One major delivery-risk item moved forward, while the remaining follow-ups are concentrated across attorney review, performance reviews, and intake decisions. Wednesday is meeting-heavy again, with the tightest overlap at 4:00 PM.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery and Denver rollout path
items.detail: Salesforce identified likely Unified Routing configuration changes for SaltClick to apply and retest, and Denver training was complete.

items.label: Finalize the Attorney Review launch and SLC coverage plan
items.detail: Confirm attorney coverage, the October rollout sequence, and the owner for any remaining Service Cloud work. Today’s session also surfaced the need to account for the attorney-review wait and late virtual appointments.

items.label: Set the revised Mental Health RFE scope
items.detail: Choose the eligible case population, review owners, and the new planning trigger after the USCIS policy change reduced the hard-deadline population.

items.label: Close the remaining performance-review follow-ups
items.detail: Confirm all five team self-reviews are recorded, schedule the remaining downward reviews before October 15, and coordinate with Eugenia so Laura receives feedback from both managers.

items.label: Prioritize the Proactive Payday Notification intake
items.detail: Confirm the request’s priority, scope, and next owner so the CFO-backed intake can move forward.

items.label: Close the loop on today’s overlapping meetings
items.detail: Collect the decisions and named next steps from the 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM sessions that Jean could not cover directly.

items.label: Lock the Close Case Taskset scope
items.detail: Define the process for voluntary termination of non-submitted cases, clarify the affected phases, and assign the next deliverable. The working session indicated that a brief manual review may be workable in the interim.

items.label: Close the overdue Sales Cloud decisions
items.detail: Confirm the owners and decision dates for the party-record migration and the Lead Source/Source Type cleanup so UAT and training can proceed.

items.label: Connect with Amy on Incident Response communications
items.detail: Confirm the Bucket 6 notification trigger, communication owner, and remaining Incident Response Guide inputs.

items.label: Clarify the held Quality-routing deadline
items.detail: Send the interim status, revised decision point, and communication owner while the work waits for the new Phase 1 matter-plan structure.

items.label: Share the new legal-guidance protocol with the remaining PMs
items.detail: Brief the remaining PMs on when to include Leo, Raquel, or Cristian and how to separate mandatory legal guidance from recommendations.

items.label: Two year-end feedback reviews were removed
items.detail: Nichole Reese removed Jean’s reviews of David Molano and Andrea Rodriguez from the current review cycle.

items.label: All No Help outcomes will receive attorney verification
items.detail: Leo’s direction in the Attorney Review working session was that an attorney should verify every No Help outcome.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Use the deployment checkpoint to review the routing retest and remaining office-readiness gaps.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Astrid 1:1, followed by blocked work time
items.detail: Astrid’s 1:1 runs until noon, with a protected work block from noon to 1:00 PM.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - EPMO and portfolio sequence
items.detail: The EPMO team meeting is followed by Jhara’s 1:1 at 3:00 PM and the Legal portfolio review at 3:30 PM.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Three-way overlap before Jean and Sara’s 1:1
items.detail: The Attorney Review working session, CoE touchpoint, and weekly-meeting prep block start together. Jean and Sara’s 1:1 begins at 4:30 PM.
